paragraphs: R' Ḥanina bar Yitzḥak. See the entry R' Ḥinena bar Yitzḥak.[^1]

notes.text: חנינא, Ḥanina, and חיננא, Ḥinena, remain distinct supplied forms. Both retain bar Yitzḥak; the English vowels are conventional. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
